credentials.description: merchant API key, sent as the field c

example_prompt: Add Paycard mobile money payment to my checkout.

paycard-amount.description: Amount in GNF, as a string of digits (e.g. "1500").

paycard-operation-reference.description: Your own reference for this transaction. If omitted, Paycard generates one.

paycard-callback-url.description: URL Paycard will POST to when the payment completes.

paycard-auto-redirect.description: Whether to redirect the user automatically after payment.

paycard-redirect-with-get.description: When 'on', Paycard redirects the user's browser to paycard-callback-url with the reference appended as the query param 'paycard-operation-reference' (e.g. ?paycard-operation-reference=2604-XXX&c=...&transaction-reference=...). No server-to-server POST is sent. Read 'paycard-operation-reference' from the query string and pass it to verify_payment.

paycard-jump-to-paycard.description: Skip payment method selection and go directly to Paycard wallet.

paycard-jump-to-cc.description: Skip payment method selection and go directly to credit card.

paycard-jump-to-om.description: Skip payment method selection and go directly to Orange Money.

paycard-jump-to-momo.description: Skip payment method selection and go directly to MTN MoMo.

operation_reference.description: Transaction reference. Store this before redirecting — required to call verify_payment later.

payment_url.description: URL to redirect the user to complete the payment. Format: https://mapaycard.com/epay/{api_key}/{reference}/

gotchas: Always verify payment status server-side by calling verify_payment before fulfilling an order. The callback URL alone is not sufficient — it can be spoofed by anyone who knows your endpoint.

Store operation_reference from the response immediately. It is the only way to call verify_payment later. If you passed your own paycard-operation-reference in the request, that same value is echoed back.
Auth is the field 'c' sent in the POST body, not an HTTP header. Do not confuse it with a Bearer token or X-Api-Key pattern.
There is no sandbox environment. All requests hit production. Test with small amounts: the minimum amount Paycard accepts is not documented in this spec set (see open_questions).

paycard-redirect-with-get: 'on' redirects the user's browser to paycard-callback-url with the reference appended as the query param 'paycard-operation-reference' (e.g. ?paycard-operation-reference=2604-XXX&c=...&transaction-reference=...). No server-to-server POST is sent. Read 'paycard-operation-reference' from the query string and pass it to verify_payment server-side before fulfilling the order.
open_questions: What is the minimum amount Paycard accepts for a payment? Paycard's docs are not public and no source in hand states it.

Is a retried create_payment safe? Paycard's docs are not public and document no idempotency key or duplicate handling that could be checked; whether Paycard rejects a reused paycard-operation-reference is unknown.
